name: Frostmaw
summary: Melor Stonehoof sends you to the Alterac Mountains to hunt Frostmaw, a rarely seen yeti. A scroll explains how to lure him, and Melor awaits Frostmaw’s mane in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: A Distant Hunt
sections.body: Melor Stonehoof says you are ready to travel far from home and hunt Frostmaw in the Alterac Mountains. The yeti’s white coat blends with the mountain snow, and he rarely shows himself. Melor gives you a scroll explaining how to lure Frostmaw. Bring his mane back to Melor in Thunder Bluff; until then, your journey remains unfinished.

faq.answer: Frostmaw is a yeti in the Alterac Mountains. His white coat blends into the snow, and he rarely appears.
Frostmaw lives in the Alterac Mountains, where his white coat blends into the snow.
Melor Stonehoof gives you a scroll with instructions for luring Frostmaw.

faq.q: What does Melor want from Frostmaw?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof asks you to bring Frostmaw’s mane to him in Thunder Bluff.
